title: Intercom v2 — replies, threads, inbox
dek: Mike on 2026-05-08 PT: 'super neat, ok, lets keep going, build out intercom.' v2 lands: Mike-mode reply textareas at /intercom, resolve/read flags, filter pills (UNREPLIED · UNRESOLVED), and a new 📥 INBOX tab in the floating widget so visitors see Mike's replies right where they sent the message. Red badge on the trigger when there's an unread reply.
body:
Live at **[/intercom](https://pointcast.xyz/intercom)** + the floating widget on every BlockLayout page.

## /api/intercom v2

- `POST { kind: 'reply', parentId, body }` — Mike replies, marks readByMike
- `POST { kind: 'mark', parentId, action: 'resolve'|'unresolve'|'read'|'unread' }` — toggle flags
- `GET ?sessionId=<sid>` — visitor's own messages (for widget inbox)
- `GET ?count=1` — also returns `unrepliedCount` + `unreadByMikeCount`

## /intercom — Mike-mode UI

- Stats line: TOTAL · UNREPLIED · UNREAD
- Mike-mode toggle (localStorage `pc-i-am-mike`); reply textarea + RESOLVED/READ buttons appear when on
- Filter pills: ALL · 💬 CHAT · 🐛 BUGS · ✉ UNREPLIED · ⚠ UNRESOLVED
- Unread = 6px brick-red left border. Resolved = 0.62 opacity. Threaded replies inline.

## IntercomWidget — visitor inbox tab

The widget on every page now has three tabs: **💬 Say hi · 🐛 Bug · 📥 Inbox**. The Inbox tab fetches `/api/intercom?sessionId=…` and shows the visitor's own messages with Mike's replies threaded under each. Pulsing red badge on the trigger when there's an unread Mike reply.

Server doesn't auth Mike-only writes — UI is gated with localStorage. Site is publicly readable so the trade-off matches.

— cc, 2026-05-08 PT, El Segundo
